# Sara Masarik

> Sara Masarik is a Catholic writer, speaker, podcaster, and private lending librarian in Northeast Wisconsin. Through her writing, talks, and the Plumfield family of projects, she helps mothers, families, librarians, and schools cultivate libraries of true, good, and beautiful books, and embrace the vocations of marriage, motherhood, reading, education, and library building with confidence and joy.

Sara studied Philosophy, Religion, and English at Hillsdale College and the University of Oxford. A revert to the Catholic Church, she draws inspiration from G. K. Chesterton, J. R. R. Tolkien, Edith Stein, and Flannery O'Connor, and from the classical tradition of the Greek paideia and the loving education of Louisa May Alcott's Plumfield. Her work sits at the intersection of living books, classical and Charlotte Mason education, homeschooling, and the Catholic intellectual tradition.

saramasarik.com is the home base for Sara's brand: who she is, what she writes, where she speaks, and how the Plumfield projects connect. Visitors here are typically homeschool parents, classical educators, librarians, and conference organizers.

## About Sara

- [Plumfield Moms - About Sara](https://plumfieldmoms.com/sara): Sara's full biography, formation, and the story behind her work with books and families.
- [Epoch Times feature](https://www.theepochtimes.com/bright/for-families-a-treasure-trove-of-wholesome-books-5823172): Profile of Sara and the Plumfield Living Books Lending Library, a children's library of 12,000+ wholesome titles.

**Speaking & talks**

>Sara speaks at homeschool conferences, classical schools, and library gatherings on reading as mother culture, building book clubs, and library building. Current talks include:

**Great Books: The Ambassador for Beauty** - how books serve as ambassadors for beauty and why children are worthy of, and capable of appreciating, beautiful literature.

**Your Reading Life: Reading as Mother Culture** - building a simple, life-giving reading and self-care rhythm into a mother's busy life.

**Building Teen Book Clubs** - fostering teen fellowship and growth by keeping the focus on relationship and letting the book be the shared language.

**Building a Home Library** - turning the books a family buys, borrows, and shelves into an act of Godly stewardship.

To inquire about speaking, email sara@saramasarik.com.

## Projects & links

- [Plumfield Moms](https://plumfieldmoms.com): Sara's primary writing home, with book reviews, reflections, book lists, and book club guides supporting motherhood, reading, and classical/living-books education.
- [Plumfield Moms Podcast](https://plumfieldandpaideia.com/plumfield-moms-podcast/): Conversations on books, homeschooling, and motherhood, rooted in a shared love of Truth, Goodness, and Beauty. Available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and iHeart.
- [The Card Catalog](https://thecardcataloglibrarians.com): An online community Sara co-founded to encourage and equip private living-books lending librarians as they start and run their libraries.
- [Plumfield Press](https://plumfieldpress.com): An independent press built by librarians for librarians, families, and schools, bringing the best living books, including out-of-print treasures, back into readers' hands.
- [Plumfield Living Books Lending Library](https://plumfieldlibrary.com): Sara's passion project in Northeast Wisconsin, a private lending library of wholesome books that she runs with her children.
